svg.aria-label: Animation of both engines generating the same story, slowed 40 times. BareMetal finishes 100 tokens in 117 milliseconds and PyTorch in 330.
svg.text: Both engines generate the same 100 tokens. Slowed 40× so you can watch.
Real output from tinyllama-15M. Each engine runs at its median time per token, 1.17 ms and 3.30 ms, on one RTX 5080. Data: benchmarks/results/
